title: A finished feature cannot be closed in the queue
what: Let `relay queue done` close a feature with the evidence that fits it (a merge sha in relay or another repo, or a report path) instead of a --test; keep the --test requirement for fixes.
why: `relay queue done` needs a taken wt/ branch and a --test (written for fixes), and `relay queue drop` records the owner's words for work not done; a feature finished without a branch of relay's own (the OpenSpec trial run) has no way to leave the queue, so it stays at the top as if open.
failing_case: Trial 2026-10-23: `trial-run-one-openspec-change-from-setup-to-merg` (feature, ip 99) finished (scratch project merged at 19c02df, 13 fix items queued from it), but no queue command closes it; it still heads `relay queue`.
pass_cases: `relay queue done <feature> --evidence <sha or report>` moves it to done and off the list; a fix without --test is still refused.
where: bin/relay (queue done, queue drop), lib/ queue module
